title: Moldova to align its Russia and Belarus sanctions with the EU
note: Kyiv Independent reports Moldova will bring its sanctions in line with the EU as a membership requirement. The EU has sanctioned over 4,700 individuals and entities over the war on Ukraine, and candidates must adopt every restriction.
